rule: A requirement is implemented only when its acceptance condition is evidenced by executable artifacts and passing tests.

requirements.acceptance: Continuous research, validation, learning, and reporting operate on the production scheduler for 30 consecutive days.
Every layer has a stable executable interface, persistence contract, owner, and contract tests.
Registers contain at least 100 papers, 250 experiments, 50 factors, 20 indicators, and 5 strategies with evidence links.
One candidate passes the entire fixed pipeline with immutable stage artifacts and no skipped gate.
Versioned 0-100 volatility, trend, momentum, liquidity, and regime features reproduce across the approved asset universe.
ATH-001 through ATH-010 have approved specifications; ATH-001 meets all declared acceptance conditions.
Walk-forward, Monte Carlo, cross-market, parameter-sensitivity, and robustness engines run reproducibly and fail closed.
Decision Court, Skeptic, Evidence Engine, Risk Manager, and Strategy Selector expose separate audited findings and cannot be bypassed.
All eight specialist services run idempotently through durable queues with bounded authority and observable health.
Approved VPS, Docker deployment, domain, TLS, health checks, restart policy, and 30-day uptime evidence exist.
PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage schemas, migrations, backups, restore test, RPO, and RTO are approved and verified.
Mission Control shows every frozen metric and the 08:00 SAST Daily Progress report is delivered from verified runtime state.
Drive structure and registers exist, connectors are authorized, and GitHub/Drive/PostgreSQL ownership and reconciliation tests pass.
Python/Pine parity tests pass and TradingView exports and alerts are ingested with immutable identifiers.
Approved portfolio, position, daily-loss, event-risk, and kill-switch policy fails closed in paper operation before live authority is considered.
All GPT calls are bounded, schema-validated, costed, attributable, retry-safe, and incapable of direct execution or policy mutation.
Freeze and traceability validations pass in CI; protected changes require a proposal and human approval.
